pages.text: Every dimension and how to open it. Each one gets its own chapter in this book when you first arrive.$(br2)$(bold)Nether$(): the vanilla obsidian portal.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight Forest$(): a 2x2 pool of water, flowers or mushrooms on the grass around it, throw in a diamond. The best first dimension.

$(bold)Aether$(): a Glowstone frame, pour water into it.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies$(): find a Gatekeeper's house in plains, mountains or snow. Buy his Zeal Lighter with emeralds and light his frame. One frame leads to the Everbright, another to the Everdawn.
$(bold)Undergarden$(): craft a Catalyst (4 iron, 4 gold, 1 diamond). Build a Stone Brick or Deepslate Brick frame in the Overworld and right-click the inside with it.

$(bold)Otherside$(): kill the Warden for the Heart of the Deep, clear the sculk off the big archway in an Ancient City, right-click the frame with the Heart.$(br2)$(bold)Lost Cities$(): a bed on top of two Diamond Blocks, surrounded by 6 skulls. Sleep in it.$(br2)$(bold)The End$(): the vanilla stronghold portal. Go last.
